The native receipt's श्राम्येत्तेन cleanly splits as श्राम्येत् + तेन. [Monier-Williams śram](https://sanskrit.uohyd.ac.in/SKT/MW/267.html) records both exhaustion and making an effort especially in austerities. Here तपोयुतः, योगार्थम्, and आदरात् select effort in austerity, not simply tiredness. The two optatives श्राम्येत् and लोकयेत् share Vakratuṇḍa as their subject and तेन ties the sight to that effort. Intra-work 9.3.71–74 similarly goes from austerity to inner vision, and [Marathi stanza 81](https://www.transliteral.org/pages/z120206104058/view) specifically confirms exertion before beholding Ekadanta in the heart. Resolve the marked sense for working Kannada without touching the printed Sanskrit.
